correctness.rationale: The final claim fixes 0<alpha<1, beta>0, stationary Cauchy scale s=sqrt(beta/(1-alpha)), bounded centered phi=(x^2-s^2)/(x^2+s^2), and excludes endpoints from the limit. Cayley conjugacy maps T to B_t(z)=z(z+t)/(1+t z), t=2alpha-1, and phi=Re z; B_t(0)=0 proves Haar invariance. The analytic iterate coefficient c_m=(1+t)t^(m-1)(1-t^m), combined with analytic/anti-analytic orthogonality, proves E[Y_iY_j]=t^|i-j|/2 and E[Y_iY_jY_k]=t^(j-i)c_(k-j)/4 for i<=j<k; later-index repeated triples vanish. Counting repeated/strictly ordered triples gives the exact finite sums. Absolute geometric convergence yields Var(S_N)/N=(1+t)/(2(1-t)) and kappa3(S_N)/N=3(1+t)/(4(1-t)^2); skewness normalization is consistent. Independently calculated 131072-point Haar-grid quadrature for t=-0.4,0,0.3 and 8 iterates reproduced ALL pair and ordered triple correlations with maximum error below 2e-16, and the N=7 third cumulant within 2e-14. These numerical values only corroborate, while the analytic proof handles every parameter.
